author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys whats up.

So over the course of a few days, right after the Avicore launch, I started working on a tips video showing you guys how to get monuments on some of the newer maps, as well as the old mczone maps. So I finished it, and here it is: http://youtu.be/EwzRexcZXms. Enjoy! Don't forget to hit like and subscribe :)
